 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The North Carolina Tar Heels are set for their toughest test of the early season. After moving to 3-0 with a win over Wyoming on Tuesday, the Tar Heels return to the court on Friday night to host the Georgia Bulldogs .
 Georgia enters this game 3-0 overall, but like the Tar Heels, they have yet to face a team as good as their opponent tonight. The Bulldogs are a solid team and will be the big test for Michael Malone as the non-conference schedule starts to get harder here in the coming weeks.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It will be a fun Friday night game in the Dean Dome and hopefully a Tar Heels' victory.
